notes: Video is 17.0 s (prompt planned 20 s); all 8 scripted lines spoken in order, no Whisper hallucinations. Greasiness villain (lines 1 and 4) has a very high squeaky voice (374-441 Hz); villain fx with -3 st to make him sly and menacing while staying playful as the prompt asks. Tube speaks lines 2, 5 ('Fired.', short 0.6 s, firm delivery at 194 Hz) and 8. Purple Tint (235 Hz) sits close to the tube (217-222 Hz), so Purple Tint gets +2 st; Niacinamide (266 Hz) +1 st; SPF Shield is the low voice (161 Hz). Tube ref includes the short 'Fired.' range; the other two tube ranges carry most of the clone.
